behavioral_effects: LLM_PROVIDER=test makes _build_model return TestModel(call_tools=[]) for the assistant and both research-service models
Settings refuse LLM_PROVIDER=test when ENVIRONMENT=production and reject unknown provider names
C:/Program Files/Git/api/v1/ready reports the fake as provider test with an explicit fake detail
Six new tests: provider selection both ways, production refusal, unknown-provider rejection, a real AssistantAgent round trip with no key, and the readiness report
compatibility_impact: LLM_PROVIDER narrows from free-form str to Literal[openrouter, test]; only openrouter was ever buildable, so no working deployment changes. _build_model returns the pydantic-ai Model base type; the assistant and research services already accept it. backend/.env.example documents the variable and ENV_VARS.md follows.
follow_up: Phase 5b: e2e CI job with LLM_PROVIDER=test, pgvector and redis services, chromium only; retire the playwright-not-in-ci exception
limitations: Simplification pass: not run; the change adds one branch, one validator and one health case
Phase 5a of the CI/CD coverage plan. The Playwright e2e job that consumes this is Phase 5b
reason: The Playwright chat specs need a model reply and the only model the backend could build was OpenRouter with a real key, so the e2e suite could never run in CI without paying for tokens and inheriting an external flake source; the backend already used TestModel for tool-schema measurement but not as a selectable provider. After this change LLM_PROVIDER=test makes _build_model, the single choke point the assistant and research services share, return TestModel, the setting is refused in production, and the health endpoint reports the fake honestly.
risks: A dev environment that sets LLM_PROVIDER=test and forgets is visible only through /ready and the reply text (success (no tool calls)); ENVIRONMENT=production is the hard stop
rollback: git revert. Nothing lives outside the repository.
security_impact: A new provider value builds a fake model. Guarded three ways: LLM_PROVIDER is a Literal so unknown values fail at startup, the field validator refuses test when ENVIRONMENT is production, and /ready reports provider test with a detail string that says fake so a monitor cannot mistake it for a configured provider. TestModel(call_tools=[]) never invokes tools, so the fake cannot reach Google, MCP, code execution or the web; the approval gating asymmetry finding is untouched because no tool runs. No key, no network.
summary: Add an LLM_PROVIDER=test path that builds the agent on pydantic-ai's TestModel so end-to-end tests can round-trip chat without a live model
